scope: Offline MLX-LM text-only process using the installed SiphonNet model weights; not SiphonNet UI reproduction
interpretation: The configured run caused substantial system paging during loading and hit the predeclared guard. It does not prove that a longer run cannot load or generate, nor measure the phone shard size needed.
limitations: One short diagnostic attempt, not repeated trials or a long-context test.
System swap includes all applications, not only model memory.
File hashes were read before timing, so this is not a cold-disk benchmark.
Dedicated MLX-Peer environment; runtime equivalence with SiphonNet has not been established. This is not exact application failure reproduction.
